question: When should the oblation be cast into the fire of mantra?
premises: Supreme delightful nectar falls from the tip of the spoon.
The oblation is directed into the fire at the mouth of mantra.
The offering is made with a mantra ending in Vaushat.
inference: At the moment the supreme nectar descends from the spoon's tip, the officiant casts a Vaushat-ending oblation into the mantra-fire.
plain_english: As the supreme, delightful nectar falls from the tip of the spoon, one should cast into the fire, at the mouth of mantra, an oblation ending with Vaushat.
